sentences.text: The Sales of Goods Act, 1930 nowhere mandates that every purchase order made by a prospective buyer to the seller has to be made in writing.
Evidently, every sale is a contract and Section 5 of Sales of Goods Act, 1930 is very clear in this regard.

Section 5 of Sale of Goods Act, 1930 describes as to how a contract for sale is made and it provides that such a contract can be made in writing or orally and even partially in writing and partially orally.

The contract made provide for the immediate delivery of the goods or immediate payment of price or both or for the delivery or payment by installments, that the delivery or payment or both shall be postponed.

(II) Subject to the provision of any law for timing and enforce, a contract of sale may be made in writing or by word of mouth or partly in writing or partly by word of mouth or may be employed by the conduct of the parties.

In the light of the above statutory provision, the insistence of Ld. Counsel for defendant that failure of the plaintiff company to place written purchase order from the defendant should leave to be dismissal of the suit is un- acceptable.
Under GST Act, 2017 no sale of a movable property can be carried out unless a GST paid invoice is issued.
Generally speaking, an invoice is a commercial instrument issued by a seller to a buyer.

It identifies both the trading parties and lists, describes, and quantifies the items sold, shows the date of shipment and mode of transport, prices and discounts, if any, and delivery and payment terms.

The relevant text is as under:
"Invoice under GST
Under the GST regime, an "invoice" or "tax invoice" means the tax invoice referred to in section 31 of the CGST Act, 2017.
This section mandates issuance of invoice or a bill of supply for every supply of goods or services or both.
It is necessary for a person CS No. 578/20 M/s Brijbihari Concast Pvt. Ltd Vs M/s Gupta Steel Traders 11/17 supplying goods or services or both to issue invoice.
